questions.q: What do Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes include?
options: Metadata only — no production records
All production data and all metadata
Only production data, with no metadata
A sampled subset of production data via a template
questions.explain: Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes copy configuration (metadata) only — objects, fields, layouts, flows, Apex — with no actual records.

questions.q: What does a Sandbox Template control when creating a Partial Copy or Full sandbox?
options: The sandbox's storage limit
Which objects, and how many records of each, get copied into the sandbox
Which users can log in to Setup
The sandbox's URL and login domain
questions.explain: A Sandbox Template is a saved definition of which objects and record volumes to include — built in Setup and reused across refreshes.

questions.q: Where would an admin check the Status of a sandbox copy that's still being created?
options: The Setup Audit Trail
A permission set's assigned users list
The Sandboxes list page, which shows Status, Location, and Release Type
The Object Manager's Feed Tracking page
questions.explain: The Sandboxes list page shows each sandbox's current Status (e.g., Processing, Completed), along with its Location and Release Type.

questions.q: What does a Release Type of 'Preview' mean for a sandbox?
options: The sandbox cannot be logged into until it's fully processed
The sandbox has no metadata yet, only a preview of the org structure
The sandbox will automatically delete itself in 24 hours
The sandbox is running the next Salesforce release ahead of when production will get it
questions.explain: A Preview release type means that sandbox has already been upgraded to the upcoming Salesforce release, letting admins test changes against it before production is upgraded.

questions.q: Why do most orgs do the bulk of day-to-day configuration work in Developer or Developer Pro sandboxes rather than Full sandboxes?
options: Full sandboxes take the longest to refresh and use the most storage, so they're reserved for testing that specifically needs real data
Developer sandboxes are the only type that supports Apex
Full sandboxes cannot have page layouts or flows changed
Only Full sandboxes require a separate license to create
questions.explain: Full sandboxes copy all production data and take the longest to create/refresh, so most configuration work happens in faster, metadata-only Developer/Developer Pro sandboxes, reserving Full for staging and final testing.
